recap: Two by two, they loaded the ark — and two by two is exactly how this game took them out. Episode 8 opened with Carter building his "Salt Alliance" with Kilby, Lewis, Cristian, Maggie and Thien An, even handing Cristian his idol to seal it. Then tree mail dropped the duos twist, and suddenly every castaway's fate was tied to somebody else's. Lewis and Sharonda outlasted the field across three stages for immunity and reward, shared it with Jelly and Kristin, and shipped Cristian off on a journey where he lost his vote, scrambled buoys into "Dig Under Treemail," and dug up both his vote and an extra one. At Tribal, Cristian gifted that extra vote to Eric, who never played it. Jelly's idol wiped out eight votes. Kristin's Shot in the Dark missed. Cristian's hit. One vote remained — Kristin and Kilby — and the first two members of our jury walked out together.
bullets: Carter named it the "Salt Alliance," and then promptly handed Cristian his idol to prove he meant it.
Lewis and Sharonda outlasted balls, blocks and Eric's nonstop commentary to take immunity and reward.
Cristian turned a lost vote into an extra vote — then gave the extra away to Eric, who sat on it until it expired.
Jelly's idol negated eight votes, Kristin's Shot in the Dark came up empty, and Cristian's came up SAFE.
One single parchment decided it: Kristin and Kilby, jurors number one and two.
draftImpact: Tim, you are having a night — 52 to 56, plus four, and all four of your castaways still standing. Tami, 42 to 45, plus three, three of five alive, with Rob not counted under best-four. Austin, a quiet plus two, 36 to 38. Kylie, you picked up a point, 31 to 32, but Danny Kilby's torch is out. And Taylor — plus zero, 31, nobody left on your board. Standings: Tim 56, Tami 45, Austin 38, Kylie 32, Taylor 31.
